Three samples of blood extracted from one voluntary donor, citrated to prevent coagulation, were treated separately to induce clot formation and consecutively to cross-link the structure.
Three samples of blood extracted from one voluntary donor... were treated separately
digested by a combination of LysC (Wako) and Trypsin (Promega)
Quantification was performed with the iBAQ (intensity-Based Absolute Quantification) algorithm
resuspended in a solution containing 1% SDC and 10 mM TCEP with 40 mM CAA (Sigma-Aldrich) as reduction and alkylating agents
fractionated with an Agilent 1200 HPLC pump system (Agilent) coupled to an Opti-LYNX trap column (Optimize Technologies) and strong cation exchange (SCX)-separation column (PolyLC)
40 mM CAA (Sigma-Aldrich) as reduction and alkylating agents
resulting in 25 fractions per fibrin clot

cross-linking buffer supplemented with 2 mM DSSO (Thermo Fisher Scientific) was pushed by centrifugal force through the filters (10 min, 6000 × g for Amicon and 14,000 × g for Microcon) in four repetitions

The final mixtures were heated to 37 °C for 5 min, the resulting clots were washed with cross-linking buffer... After these steps, cross-linking buffer supplemented with 2 mM DSSO... was pushed by centrifugal force through the filters

The final peptide mixtures were desalted with BioSelect solid-phase extraction C18 columns... and fractionated with an Agilent 1200 HPLC pump system (Agilent) coupled to an Opti-LYNX trap column (Optimize Technologies) and strong cation exchange (SCX)-separation column (PolyLC), resulting in 25 fractions per fibrin clot.
